themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Chips had their worst week since the one after 9/11: the PHLX chip index fell about 17% (Yahoo Finance). On Friday Nov 20 Nvidia fell 14.01% to 125.53, its seventh straight weekly loss, the longest since 2008 (CNBC), after a report that the SEC is looking into its disclosures (reported by the Wall Street Journal and Reuters; the SEC does not comment). AMD fell 13.25% to 424.39, Broadcom 12.19% to 304.41, Micron 13.89% to 594.51 and TSMC's US shares 9.48% to 318.71 (Massive closes).
themes.for_you: A legal probe on the leader adds a risk that price alone does not show. ANET closed 167.62 and ENTG 124.53, both off the long term scan buy list and well under their points. No chip puts, no first pieces, and no swing entries in the group until it holds a low and closes up on rising volume.
